primitives.name: Market Availability Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: BOOKMAKER | SPORTS | PRE-MATCH | LIVE | PROPS | MARKETS | DETAILS ---------------------------------------Bet365 | Football
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'M': 'Market type (dimensionless)', 'B': 'Bookmaker identifier (dimensionless)', 'T': 'Time domain (pre-match, live, prop)', 'S': 'Sport category (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Each market is independently available per bookmaker and sport.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When T = 'prop' and S ≠ 'Football', availability drops to 0.5.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a conditional probability P(M|B,S,T) in GSI; GSE models state transition via M(B,S,T) → M'(B,S,T+Δt).
layer2.telemetry: Observable: number of active markets per bookmaker-sport combination.

primitives.name: Betting Propensity Tensor
primitives.verbatim_quote: | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | 187 Player props Corners Cards Halves | Details Betfair
primitives.assumptions: Prop counts are additive and independent across categories.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When P < 10, tensor rank reduces to 2D.

layer2.mapping: Derived from market kernel as P(C,H,K) = f(M,B,S,T); GSE uses this to compute dynamic risk-weighted prop exposure.
layer2.telemetry: Observable: total prop count per market segment.

primitives.name: Real-Time Market State
primitives.verbatim_quote: +9 more | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | 61 Player props Corners Cards Halves |
primitives.assumptions: Market state evolves deterministically with E and D.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When D > 100ms, R drops below 10 Hz.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a time-series process in GSI; GSE models state transitions via E(t) → E(t+Δt).
layer2.telemetry: Observable: latency-adjusted real-time market update frequency.

The primitives form a hierarchical Bayesian network where market availability is the root node, followed by propensity tensors that define market richness, and finally real-time states that govern temporal dynamics. The kernel operator maps discrete bookmaker-sport combinations into probabilistic availability, while the tensor operator encodes multi-dimensional prop counts. Real-time state introduces stochasticity through latency and event progression. Dualities emerge between static market structure and evolving event dynamics. Failure modes include data inconsistency when T=prop and S≠Football, or when D exceeds threshold, causing cascading model degradation.
